scope: Bounded longer-copy locator and failed-transfer stage; local verification only

commands.command:
ruby -rjson -rdigest -ruri -e '
base=ARGV.fetch(0); review_path=File.join(base,"independent-review.json")
r=JSON.parse(File.read(review_path)); result=r.fetch("command_history").last.fetch("actual_result")
pins=result.fetch("pins"); mismatches=[]
pins.each do |path,expected|
  actual=File.binread(path)
  mismatches << path unless actual.bytesize==expected.fetch("bytes") && Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(actual)==expected.fetch("sha256")
end
raise "independent review source-pin mismatch" unless mismatches.empty?
raise "unexpected independent check count" unless result.fetch("assertions")==89 && result.fetch("failed").empty?
source_json=Dir.glob(File.join(base,"**","*.json"))
source_json.each{|p| JSON.parse(File.read(p))}
receipt=JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(base,"acquisition-receipt.json")))
raise "procedure changed" unless Digest::SHA256.file(File.join(base,"acquire_candidates.py")).hexdigest==receipt.fetch("procedure_sha256")
raise "expected exactly two HTTP 403 receipts" unless receipt.fetch("results").size==2 && receipt.fetch("results").all?{|x| x.fetch("http_status")==403 && x.fetch("status")=="failed_preserve_partial_if_present"}
raise "unexpected acquired media" unless Dir.children(File.join(base,"media")).empty?
report=File.join(base,"report.md"); text=File.read(report)
links=text.scan(/\]\(([^)]+)\)/).flatten.reject{|x| x.start_with?("https://","http://","#")}
missing=links.reject{|x| File.exist?(File.expand_path(x.split("#").first,base))}
raise "unexpected missing link" unless missing==["final-verification.json"]
hashes={}
["report.md","PROTOCOL.md","METADATA-ADDENDUM.md","ACQUISITION-ADDENDUM.md","acquire_candidates.py","acquisition-receipt.json","independent-review.json","sources/public-search-log.json"].each do |n|
  p=File.join(base,n); hashes[n]={bytes:File.size(p),sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest}
end
puts JSON.pretty_generate({status:"pass",review_assertions:89,independent_pins_rechecked:pins.size,json_files_parsed:source_json.size,local_report_links:links.size,existing_local_links:links.size-missing.size,pending_receipt_link:missing,media_files:0,http_403_receipts:2,hashes:hashes,limits:"Read-only local checks; no network event reproduced, acquired-media verification, content match or source authenticity."})
